title: UWell Crown X Replacement Pod
description:
Description
Specifications
Note: Sold as pairs.
The UWell Crown X Replacement Pod has a 3.3ml e-liquid capacity with an integrated coil. The UWell Crown X Replacement Pod features a top fill design, meaning you simply push the drip tip off the pod with your thumb. The UWell Crown X Replacement Pod is available in 0.3ohm and 0.6ohm resistances.
3.3ml E-liquid Capacity
Available in 0.3ohm and 0.6ohm
